_comment: Valinor Smart Cuff GUI update manifest. This feed accepts only
v3.2.* releases and is intentionally separate from version.json.
The installed client needs no GitHub credential and fails silently offline.
notes: Cal 3 flow calibration follows the MAP paper and now integrates over measured time: earlier Valinor flow gains are about 5 % high; re-run Cal 3 per device. Apply PID now reads the controller's gains and sends only changed values (earlier versions overwrote SysID inflation gains). File/Edit/View menus; device actions refuse without a link; STOP from every tab and Esc; launcher checks the controller's firmware; failed updates relaunch the old copy. Firmware rev27v-gauge-34 unchanged. Offline tests 916 passed / 35 skipped. Unsigned online installer: More info, verify SmartCuff_Setup.exe from this repository, then Run anyway.
